title: 'A thoroughly intriguing contest': I tested LG's latest flagship OLED against Samsung's latest flagship RGB TV, and while I know which I'd recommend, it's a very close call
summary: As for fullscreen brightness, where mini-LED often succeeds, the G6 hit 451 nits fullscreen HDR brightness in Filmmaker Mode, while the R95H hit 612 nits. In Speed Racer , both TVs deliver vibrant, punchy colors that really pop on screen.
